description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the s_pop frequency (x-axis) and accuracy (y-axis) for two different models or conditions. The x-axis is labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^4)" and ranges from 1 to 19, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line represents one model or condition, starting at an accuracy of approximately 0.8 at a s_pop frequency of 1, peaking at around 1.0 at a s_pop frequency of 5, and then declining to approximately 0.8 at a s_pop frequency of 19. The green solid line represents another model or condition, starting at an accuracy of approximately 0.4 at a s_pop frequency of 1, peaking at around 0.8 at a s_pop frequency of 5, and then declining to approximately 0.2 at a s_pop frequency of 19.
